warnings.message: Missing values were stored as '?' and converted to empty.

Five columns (caused_by, vendor, cmdb_ci, rfc, problem_id) are 98-100% empty and were reduced to yes/no flags.

recommendations.title: Route tickets to the right team first time
recommendations.description: Use the model's category/symptom signals to suggest the correct team at opening; require a reason when reassigning.
evidence: RC1: Breach rate rises from 22% with no reassignment to 43% after one and 86% after five or more.
recommendations.estimate_method: Tickets with 2+ reassignments in the current period assumed to breach at the 1-reassignment rate.
assumptions: Better routing cuts repeat reassignments, not the first one

recommendations.title: Fast-track the 10% highest-risk tickets
recommendations.description: Every new ticket in the model's top 10% risk goes to a senior agent within 1 hour.
evidence: RISK: The 10% of tickets the model flags hold 28% of all breaches (2.75x the normal rate).
recommendations.estimate_method: Assumes fast-tracking prevents 30% of breaches among flagged tickets (to be validated in a pilot).

recommendations.title: Rebalance workload away from Group 20
recommendations.description: Move part of Group 20's incoming tickets to teams with spare capacity, or add temporary staff.
evidence: RC2: Group 20 breached 40% of its 302 tickets this period vs 22% overall.
recommendations.estimate_method: Team assumed to reach the overall breach rate after rebalancing.
assumptions: Receiving teams have the skills and spare capacity
